title: Primeiros passos com a integração via API
summary: Getting-started guide for the uMov.me field-service REST API. Explains how to obtain an API token (via the Center settings UI or POST /token.xml with login credentials), the URL structure with the token embedded in the path, and the XML-based request/response format. Shows example calls for agents, schedules, service locations and items, response envelope structure (<result> with resourceName/resourceId/link or size/entries), HTTP status codes, pagination via paging.page, and the 4 requests/second rate limit. It is a guide page rather than documentation of a single entity.
auth: API token embedded in the URL path after /CenterWeb/api/. Token is a hex string generated in the Center's API settings, or obtained via POST /token.xml with login credentials in XML body. Regenerating the token invalidates existing integrations. Token required on every request; 401 returned for invalid key.

title: Código ASCII para escapar caracteres - API
summary: Guide page (not an entity reference) explaining how to escape special characters in uMov.me API requests. Values with special characters must be wrapped in XML CDATA sections, and certain characters must additionally be percent-escaped by ASCII code: % as %25 and & as %26 (e.g. <![CDATA[%25]]>). Line breaks inside values are represented literally inside CDATA, and the whitespace/line break between the lines must be preserved for it to work. For other special characters the page refers to an external XML FAQ (http://xml.silmaril.ie/cgi-bin/search-faq?term=). No endpoints, entities, authentication or pagination are documented on this page.
notes: Escape table: % -> %25, & -> %26, wrapped in CDATA (e.g. <observation><![CDATA[%26]]></observation>). Line breaks: include the literal line break inside CDATA and preserve the whitespace between lines (e.g. <observation><![CDATA[teste\nteste2]]></observation>). Other special characters: consult http://xml.silmaril.ie/cgi-bin/search-faq?term=. Relevant for SDK: implement a CDATA + percent-escape encoder for XML payload string fields.

title: Tarefas e relacionados - Schedule Routing (Roteirizador de tarefas)
summary: Documents the uMov.me Schedule Routing API, which orders (routes) a set of tasks (schedules) for an agent based on geographic coordinates. It can optionally update task priorities/statuses (e.g., moving tasks from 'Em Preparação' to 'Pendente de Envio para Campo').
